claims.quote: High Caliber Line (HCL) is a family-owned and operated business that has been a trusted name in the promotional products industry since 1999.
claims.statement: High Caliber Line (HCL) is a trusted name in the promotional products industry.

claims.quote: From our humble beginnings specializing in lapel pins, we've grown into an award-winning company with over 25 years of experience.
claims.statement: High Caliber Line has over 25 years of experience.

claims.quote: Today, we operate three state-of-the-art facilities in the Greater Los Angeles area, including a 100,000 sq. ft. production and office space in Southern California, where we produce approximately 30 million items annually.
claims.statement: HCL operates three state-of-the-art facilities in the Greater Los Angeles area.
